Buttons, selectors & action labels

    Main user journeys

    Create and open a booking

    Directory → Direct booking → local draft row → Overview → Edit. The prototype does not create a complete durable booking.

    Arrange suppliers and services

    Vendors → Catalog / manual line → Assign vendor → Contact → Vouchers. Assignment/contact are placeholder submissions.

    Prepare travellers and documents

    Travellers → Add traveller → Documents → Request → message draft. A draft is not a delivered document request.

    Collect customer funds

    Finance → Add instalment → Record payment. The current DOM status change is not a shared Finance ledger entry.

    Track fulfilment and voucher blockers

    Tasks → Add task → Done. Blocked voucher → Vendors; View voucher → file metadata → Replace. Readiness remains fixture data.

    Accepted transport supplier obligation

    Approved Proposal → snapshot + actuals → supplier reference → confirmed payable → Finance reads one obligation per hire. Customer selling-price changes require a separate decision.
